review_method: Read each current case answer or operational conversation and its case-specific decision boundary across all20families; inspect customer facts and scoring/operations for overlap candidates and all81 selected compound cases. Compare the required decision after removing superficial names/amount changes. Prior r3/r4 findings supplied comparison targets, but no old canonical or evaluation content was read. No lexical uniqueness or label count used as substantive proof.

meaningfully_distinct_neighbours.required_difference: Possible modern treatment encounters an express recharge exception; ordinary treatment instead reaches the same-admission/expiry precedence dependency.
Instalment lateness, accelerated-debt remittance, unpaid annual renewal and conflicting within-term instalment clauses are different triggers and ledgers.
Earlier NICU before requested addition tests historical membership applicability; combined mother/newborn bills test person/grant allocation. Both need the common newborn exclusion.
Already named new child versus pending new spouse and a both-spouses delivery condition create different membership/credit dependencies.
New-entry age eligibility and renewal premium-band age select different contractual events despite similar birthday arithmetic.
Completed screening versus further testing plus blocked payment are different persisted states; the latter must preserve payment authorization without issuance.
A sales-closed website without a formal withdrawal event differs from stipulated withdrawal date and renewal61days later; only the latter can perform the90day-window calculation.
An unselected wait-reducing option affects existing-disease timing; an omitted OPD grant affects whether the service benefit exists.

Listed haemodialysis with established PED, unknown daycare technology/procedure qualification, necessity-only clinic argument and a known failed own-theatre criterion exercise different missing/failed gates.
Actual delivery date relative to anniversary differs from lifetime event counting independent of paid claims/children.
Row classification/package subsumption, admissible-base co-pay and inclusive procedure-cap arithmetic are separate operations.
An elapsed relapse interval still needs definition linkage; unknown clinical relatedness cannot be coerced false. Keep the interval and clinical uncertainty obligations separate.
Independent second-insurer admissibility, threshold membership of a base-refused expense and prevention of duplicate indemnity payments are distinct monetary roles.
Moratorium chronology, portable bonus credit and accepted amount-layer waiting credit use different clocks/amount semantics.
Incomplete negative search is uncertainty; explicit later network departure changes a previously positive observation.
Corrected advice across inception, initially supplied pre-inception symptoms, ordinary fact correction and correction during running inference require different chronology/concurrency behavior.
